themes.name: Glass
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Translucent panels with a fine border and backdrop blur. Made for wallpaper backgrounds.

themes.name: Bold
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Large radius, deep shadow and your theme accent on every control.

themes.name: Monochrome
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Black, white and grey only. Every module is desaturated, including ones with their own colours. Thin outlines, no shadows, text does the talking.

themes.name: Material
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Material Design 3 baseline: lavender-white tonal surfaces, the M3 purple, elevated 12dp cards, pill controls, Google Sans, and expressive shapes on the page.

tokens.font_family: "Google Sans Text", "Google Sans", Roboto, "Roboto Flex", system-ui, sans-serif

themes.name: Neumorphic Light
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Soft UI in a pale grey: one material lit from the top-left, raised cards and controls, recessed panels, no lines anywhere.

themes.name: Neumorphic Dark
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Soft UI in charcoal: one material lit from the top-left, raised cards and controls, recessed panels, no lines anywhere.

themes.name: Liquid Glass
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Apple Liquid Glass: clear glass over a pale blue-to-pink wallpaper that bends what is behind it at the edge. Blur, refraction, rim light, capsule controls.

themes.name: Hillary
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Linen, pine ink and taupe with gold accents, a hydrangea tucked into the odd corner. A Nancy Meyers palette in Ralph Lauren tailoring: warm, elevated, unhurried.

tokens.font_family: 'Playfair Display', 'Didot', 'Bodoni 72', 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

themes.name: Moose
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: All browns, like a moose: dark cocoa hide, antler-cream text, saddle-brown controls and a warm tan accent.

themes.name: Metallic
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: A brushed-aluminium plate with spun-metal controls and panes, like a hi-fi front panel. Dark engraved type, near-black tracks with a lit blue fill.

themes.name: Beach
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Sand cards with waves lapping the bottom edge, a sun glow, sand grain and a rope hairline. Every card scatters its own crabs, starfish and sand dollars. Deep-water text, ocean controls, coral accents.

themes.name: Vapor
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Vaporwave: midnight purple, a striped sunset sun, a cyan perspective grid, VHS scanlines and a hot-pink neon rim. Every card is a different frame: some get the sun, some the grid, some both, some just stars.

themes.name: Gummy
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Gummy-bear cards: every card its own candy colour, rendered as translucent jelly that catches the light differently on each card. Dark-plum ink, liquorice controls.

themes.name: Wood
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Varnished mahogany planks with real grain, seams and knots, offset per card. Pale maple controls, amber indicators, routed recesses.

themes.name: Green Terminal
themes.author: Ultra Card
themes.description: Green phosphor on black. Monospace type, square corners, hairline borders and a glow. Everything on the card is tinted green.

tokens.font_family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
